homeFaq.q: Does the installer change my files without asking?
homeFaq.a: No. It shows every change as a diff first, and nothing is written until you confirm. Files that change are backed up to `.agent-kit/backup/`, and `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md` and settings files are merged, never overwritten.

homeFaq.q: Which AI coding tools does it work with?
homeFaq.a: {toolCount} named tools, including Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot and Gemini CLI, plus any other agent that reads `AGENTS.md`. Each one gets the kit in its own format.

homeFaq.q: How much context does it use?
homeFaq.a: The always-on rules in `AGENTS.md` are about 600 tokens per session. The full rulebook is reference: skills and agents open only the section they need.

homeFaq.q: Does it need dependencies or make network calls?
homeFaq.a: `npx` downloads only the installer and the kit, about 100 kB with no dependencies. Once running, the installer makes no network calls.

homeFaq.q: How do I update or uninstall it?
homeFaq.a: Run the installer again. It offers Update, Add or remove components or tools, and Uninstall. Uninstall removes only what the kit added and keeps your own edits.
The installer and the format hook run on Node, so they work as is, though Windows hasn't been tested by hand yet. The optional pre-commit check is a POSIX `sh` script, which Git for Windows provides.

faq.q: Should I keep both AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md?
faq.a: Keep your rules in `AGENTS.md`, which most tools read, and keep `CLAUDE.md` for anything specific to Claude Code plus a one-line `@AGENTS.md` import. Then every tool reads the same rules and you edit them in one place.

faq.q: How do I make Claude Code use AGENTS.md?
faq.a: Add a line containing `@AGENTS.md` to `CLAUDE.md`. Claude Code imports the file it names, so it reads the same rules as every other tool.
It reads `GEMINI.md` by default. Add `AGENTS.md` to `context.fileName` in `.gemini/settings.json` and it reads both.

faq.q: Which tools need extra setup to read AGENTS.md?
faq.a: Claude Code (an `@AGENTS.md` import in `CLAUDE.md`), Gemini CLI (a `context.fileName` setting) and Aider (`read: AGENTS.md` in `.aider.conf.yml`). Zed and JetBrains Junie read it unless another rules file takes precedence.
